launch_networking_process: launch a networking process that starts a websocket server for HITL client connections
terminate_networking_process: terminate the running networking process and clean up the multiprocessing handle
NetworkManager_handle_connection: handle an incoming websocket client connection and assign it to a user slot
NetworkManager_send_keyframes: send consolidated keyframes to connected websocket clients in a continuous async loop
start_http_availability_server: start an HTTP server that returns availability status codes for the HITL websocket service
